title: Safety is Contextual, LLM-Judges Are Not: Navigating the Rigid Priors of Evaluators
reasoning: The paper explores how LLM judges handle diverse and culturally specific safety policies, explicitly discussing religious topics such as preaching/evangelising and regional safety differences like alcohol norms in Arabic nations. It investigates the conflict between a model's internal moral/safety priors and the specific ethical guidelines provided in-context.
